title: Great professionalism on the part of the guide.
text:
I have a habit of doing a Free Tour wherever I go, and perhaps this has been the best one.
It was very enjoyable for us, but the best part was the level of detail, the guide's preparation, the possibility he gave to expand on information, and above all, addressing such a delicate topic as the war without taking a position at all; I thought he was a professional of the highest
caliber. 100% recommended, ask for Donato, he's a star!!
author: vrd87

title: Enlightening walk through living history
text: Our guide, Henrieta, was very knowledgeable and was able to present a wealth of information in a way that kept our children's attention - no easy task!

author: Tourist29036817935

title: The recent history of Spain is amazing!
text:
This was an in depth discussion of the history of Spain from 1900 to the present.   It was a very complicated time.  Our guide was an expert and gave us a lot to think about.   I really enjoyed learning about this time and now will read more about it. Anarchists, fascists, dictatorship,  revolution :  lots of resonance with current times. 

If you aren’t into history, this tour might be overwhelming.
author: 411marthaw

title: 10 stars for a walking history lesson
text: This is one of the best tours I’ve ever taken. Henrietta has done so much research and prepared amazing materials to give us a walking history lesson of the Spanish revolution in Barcelona. If you like history and want to understand more about the culture of this wonderful city, I highly recommend this tour. You need to have a curious mind and love to learn.
author: 257marcies

title: Best tour ever!
text: Excellent guide! Very knowledgeable and good communicator. Highly recommend.
author: 190amys

title: Best Historical Walking Tour We’ve Done
text: Absolutely, without a doubt, book this tour. Yannis was our tour guide. He is an absolute gold mine of knowledge and you can feel his passion for the subject. This is by far one of the best historical walking tours we’ve ever done. We were there about during the large demonstrations and Yannis was able to tie back historical context to current. He could also easily tie back context to each of the tour participants’ countries. Seriously, cannot recommend this tour enough to get an understanding of the culture.
author: Sara_B

title: Great Tour, highlight of our trip
text: Fabulous tour, so interesting and very well told by Yannis. He knew the history so well and told the story with passion. We really enjoyed the tour and learned a lot we didn’t know.
author: Gail_F
